newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Handelsbanken says has 98.57 pct of Stadshypotek.
newsitem.headline: Handelsbanken says has 98.57 pct of Stadshypotek.

text.p: Sweden's Handelsbanken said on Friday that it now had 98.57 percent of the shares of mortgage bank Stadshypotek.
This is the final outcome of the takeover that creates Swedish largest bank.
Handelsbanken said in a statement that about 48,000 or 10 percent of those who have accepted the offer have chosen to wait before deciding the method of payment.
It said the maximum number of preference shares which may be issued by Handelsbanken is 2.8 million, worth 532 million crowns.
The bank said it expected the propectus and application form for the method of payment to be sent out at the end of April.
The takeover bid, valued at 22.9 billion crowns, was launched in December and quashed a proposal from insurer Skandia to merger with Stadshypotek.
